body:
Slice 1 of #4277.

## Why

`crates/plandb/src/schema.rs:44-62` — the `issues` table has no GitHub identity. After publish, nothing links a local row to the issue it created, so re-publish matches by **title string** (`publishSteps.ts:303`) and stream-labelling matches by **digits scraped out of the ref** (`publishSteps.ts:358`).

The ref-scraping is already broken in practice: `featuresToPlanIssues` sets `ref: f.slug` (`featureList.ts:124`) — kebab-case, not numeric. `applyStreamLabels` parses `NaN`; `groupRefsByRepo` drops the ref at its numeric-only guard (`issueStateQuery.ts:42`). So the Glance done-overlay resolves **only hand-maintained numeric refs** and is blind to every planner-authored issue. An identity column fixes that without touching the overlay's logic.

## Scope

- Add `gh_number INTEGER`, `gh_node_id TEXT`, `synced_at INTEGER` to `issues`, via the existing additive `ALTER TABLE` migration pattern (`schema.rs:184`).
- Carry them on `PlanIssue` (skip-serialize when unset, so the `issues.json` projection is unchanged for an unsynced row).
- **A content upsert must not clobber them** — the same rule `status` already has (`issues.rs:103-106`, guarded by `content_upsert_does_not_reset_status`).
- `createIssues` (`publishSteps.ts:311`) writes `number` + `node_id` back after creating.
- Re-publish matches on `gh_number` first; the title match stays only as the fallback for rows that predate this.
- `bsc plan get` / `list --full` expose the fields.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Migration is additive and a no-op on an already-migrated store.
- [ ] Re-publishing after a title rename updates the existing GitHub issue instead of creating a second one.
- [ ] A content upsert preserves `gh_number` (regression test, mirroring `content_upsert_does_not_reset_status`).
- [ ] Glance's done-overlay resolves planner-authored (slug-ref) issues via `gh_number`.
